$comment: The documentation standard's data: which Markdown files are human-facing and what the canonical footer links to. Canonical rule: rules/dev/documentation-standards.md. Checker: scripts/check-doc-standards.sh (make check-doc-standards; --fix repairs footers and Mermaid init lines). Globs match the repo-relative path; `*` and `**` both match across `/`. A null URL is derived from `git remote get-url origin`: question_url becomes https://<host>/<owner>, issue_url becomes https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/issues/new/choose (GitLab hosts: /-/issues/new). mermaid.init_file is resolved relative to this file and holds the one canonical %%{init}%% line, verbatim.
